name: Ontario EpLink TLE multimodal cohort (Brain-CODE)

repo.accession: Controlled release 'Multi-modal Imaging Investigations of Individuals with Temporal Lobe Epilepsy and Excisions' v1.0 (2025-12-10)

access.steps: Register on Brain-CODE, then request access to the controlled release.

cohort.types: temporal lobe epilepsy; 72 with excision and post-op outcomes
cohort.sites: 2 Ontario surgical centres (UHN Toronto; Western University, London)

modalities: Structural MRI, diffusion MRI, resting-state fMRI, limited EEG, clinical, cognitive tests
outcomes: Seizure control and memory outcomes after surgery
caveats: No descriptor paper found; details are from the release page and OBI news
checks: Brain-CODE controlled-release listing and OBI announcement (files not opened: approval needed).
pipeline: Second build-and-validate cohort (DWI + outcomes) independent of UCLH; uniquely adds memory outcomes for a cognitive-cost term.
key_claim: 118 TLE patients (72 operated with outcomes) + 46 controls with T1/DWI/rs-fMRI; approval required.

evidence.quote: this deeply phenotyped multi-modal resource features 118 patients, including 72 with surgical outcomes, from two Ontario epilepsy surgical centers.
Also included are MRI scans from 46 controls from the two scanners.
